source_fact_vs_inference.finding: Wood-to-metal connections retain the wood placement provisions; applicable metal placement requirements also apply.

Both lesser-of operands are wood lengths: fastener length in a wood main member and total length in wood side members. Steel thickness is not a wood operand. The footnote does not state an absent-member convention.
Yield-equation main/side bearing lengths and bearing strengths are material-specific equation inputs. Their generic steel-bearing length is distinct from TableD wood-qualified ell.
For a single-shear bolted calculation, main/side designation is interchangeable when all corresponding properties remain consistently assigned.

The row-spacing discussion includes metal side plates. Its wood-only length-ratio instruction occurs under Edge Distance; the row paragraph explains summing wood-side bearing in three-or-more-wood-member joints.

Use the minimum of the existing wood-member bearing lengths. This gives ell=88.9mm regardless of EYM labels and retains the current5D endpoint. It is coherent with wood-based placement and historical commentary, but the absent-operand convention is inferred rather than an explicit 2024 TableD sentence.
Relabelling a complete single-shear EYM changes equation labels only; it provides no placement waiver and cannot turn steel thickness or an absent wood member into a favorable TableD wood length.
